ImageDescription.value: High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing raw chicken drumsticks and thighs arranged on foil with chopped potatoes, sliced onion, whole garlic cloves, and fresh rosemary, lightly seasoned and ready for oven roasting. Photographed in San Francisco. This image documents simple cooking with limited ingredients as part of the Foodie Disorder global food culture archive.
